responsibility: Specializes the Arm backend for NetBSD ELF targets using the AAPCS/EABI configuration. It sets EABI multilib defaults and linker emulation suffix logic, selects the AAPCS-Linux ABI, enables DWARF2 unwinding instead of ARM EHABI, defines NetBSD plus optional BPABI preprocessor builtins, overrides fundamental C type sizes to match NetBSD expectations, and provides NetBSD-specific assembler and linker specs for EABI-based targets.
